identity.fantasy: A timeline conductor who changes Epoch's behavior with Aeons, blankets allies in recovery effects, and rewrites group damage with large temporal interventions.
identity.one_line: A proactive healer using Accelerated Recovery, Epoch, Aeons, Ripple, shields, damage delay, cooldown resets, and time-stasis utility. Aeons alter the same core spells for throughput, protection, or damage support. It is exceptionally flexible, but the player must understand which time mode is active and anticipate damage rather than only react.

mechanics.core_loop: Maintain Accelerated Recovery on likely recipients, change Aeons to suit the next damage pattern, cast Epoch into those prepared allies, and use Ripple or Correct the Mistake for group recovery. At level 50, Epic Recovery and Eternity Warper make both HoT coverage and active Aeon selection central.
mechanics.single_target: Epoch and Reverse Wound handle focused recovery, with the current Aeon trading speed, mana, shields, or raw healing.
mechanics.aoe: Correct the Mistake and Ripple supply group healing; Epic Recovery makes Epoch echo onto allies already carrying Accelerated Recovery.
mechanics.movement_and_target_switching: Pre-applied HoTs preserve healing during movement, but Ripple channels and Epoch casts still create positioning windows.
mechanics.defense_and_control: Fortify Timeline, Aeon of Protection, Continuum Restoration, and The Vast Infinite provide prevention, cleansing, and emergency damage redistribution.
mechanics.group_utility: Mass dispel, external haste, mass resurrection, control, and Aeon-dependent recovery make utility a defining part of the kit.

failure_modes.text: Using the wrong Aeon for the incoming damage pattern makes the same Epoch cast slower, costlier, or less protective than intended.
Movement or a target swap can interrupt the intended payoff: pre-applied hots preserve healing during movement, but ripple channels and epoch casts still create positioning windows.

Spending recovery or control too early leaves less protection for the next pressure event: fortify timeline, aeon of protection, continuum restoration, and the vast infinite provide prevention, cleansing, and emergency damage redistribution.
